title: Classification of Simple Harish-Chandra Modules over the Loop Mirror HeisenbergVirasoro Algebra
summary: The loop mirror Heisenberg-Virasoro algebra, an embedded subalgebra of the loop Heisenberg-Virasoro algebra, admits a family of interesting truncated subalgebras including those of Takiff type and \(\mathfrak{bms}_3\) type. We give a complete classification of simple Harish-Chandra modules over the loop mirror Heisenberg-Virasoro algebra, whose simple modules fall into three categories, highest weight modules, lowest weight modules, and evaluation modules of the intermediate series.
